Work closely with management, system designers, and lab validation teams to evolve the architecture and meet standard and product requirements Evaluate circuit topologies and recommend implementations based on tradeoffs across power, area, bandwidth, and technology constraints. Drive extraction-based post-layout simulations and validate transmitter performance (bandwidth, linearity/RLM, return loss, jitter, and power) across process, voltage, and temperature conditions. Experience: 10+ years of industrial experience designing high-speed analog, mixed-signal, or SerDes transmitter circuits in advanced CMOS technologies, including schematic design through post-layout verification. Application of transmitter circuit building blocks including DAC-based output stages, serializers or multiplexers, output drivers, and clocking circuits. Execution of post-layout and extraction-based simulations to validate performance across process, voltage, and temperature conditions. Delivery of analog circuit designs through silicon validation. review_candidates.title: VP, Sales, Government
review_candidates.description: Property intelligence is reshaping how the world understands the built environment, and Nearmap is driving that. We put powerful aerial imagery, AI-driven analytics, and geospatial tools into the hands of the people who plan, build, insure, and govern the places we all live and work. Our technology turns property uncertainty into decisive action, and our culture brings out the best in the people who build it. We move fast, we care about craft, and we're proud of what we're building. If you're energized by turning hard problems into real-world impact, we'd love to meet you. Job Description We're looking for a Vice President Sales, Government to build and lead the team that puts Nearmap's aerial imagery and property intelligence into the hands of the agencies planning, protecting, and maintaining America's communities. You'll own net-new and expansion revenue across city, county, and state government accounts, coaching a team that spans SMB through enterprise and deals from five figures to $1M+. This is a build-and-scale leadership role: you'll set the sales strategy, create a culture of accountability and high performance, and represent Nearmap in front of senior public sector stakeholders. If you're energized by developing sellers, sharpening pipeline discipline, and turning a growing team into a predictable revenue engine, this is the role for you. Own and drive both net-new bookings and expansion revenue within existing government accounts, partnering closely with Customer Success to identify and execute upsell opportunities (post-sale retention and renewal execution sit with CS) Lead and coach a team of government sales reps spanning SMB through enterprise and strategic accounts, with deal sizes from five figures to $1M+ and wide variation in rep seniority and tenure Coach up, and where needed coach out and backfill, supporting the team to find net-new and upsell opportunities across their territories Cascade the company vision into individual goals, OKRs, and KPIs so the team's daily work ladders up to Nearmap's strategy Manage sales engagement personally for high-value prospects and customers, building strong relationships with senior public sector stakeholders alongside our other sales leaders Set, monitor, and drive weekly, monthly, and quarterly activity and performance targets for the government sales team Plan, direct, and control sales strategy to meet targets for direct government accounts, and develop and execute a sales plan aligned to the broader strategic plan Drive pipeline qualification rigor: enforce clear qualification criteria before opportunities enter forecast, and actively manage stage aging to eliminate stale pipeline Analyze, evaluate, and optimize sales and customer processes, and manage initiatives aimed at improving the efficiency of the existing operation Map key stakeholders, technical requirements, and business process for target accounts Partner with Marketing on strategy, campaigns, and demand generation, and contribute input into new products, marketing techniques, and incentive schemes Build and maintain healthy working relationships across Technology, Product, Marketing, Engineering, Finance, RevOps, FlightOps, Customer Success, and People & Culture Establish a high degree of Salesforce compliance and efficiency within the team, and build effective reporting using Salesforce, Looker, and Gong to manage performance and forecast accurately Use AI tools for business analysis, forecasting, and strategic account planning at a leadership level Provide detailed performance reporting, insights, and forecast accountability, and share sales data transparently across the business Recruit and select high performers, own complete onboarding for new starters, develop talent, and recognize and reward performance Create a culture of accountability with clear objectives, KPIs, and processes, and drive high performance through consistent coaching and quality feedback Run regular team meetings, one-on-ones, coaching sessions, side-by-sides, and call shadowing to review performance, share knowledge, and develop the team Identify training and development needs and provide the resources to close them Drive additional revenue opportunities by applying incremental programs or projects initiated by the SVP Sales, Commercial and Government Qualifications 8+ years of experience managing quota-carrying reps, including at least 3 years in a SaaS sales leadership role Experience selling into the public sector, particularly city and state government Demonstrated ability to lead effective sales teams with a proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets Proven leadership capability developing and coaching high-performing teams, with the ability to set high standards and mentor an evolving workforce at varying levels of experience Strong command of sales numbers and daily sales metrics, with experience coaching using tools such as Gong Thorough understanding of subscription business models and strong negotiation skills Strong commercial acumen and the enthusiasm to coach at all levels High competence with CRM platforms, ideally Salesforce Excellent written, visual, and verbal presentation skills, with the ability to prepare reports, make a compelling sales argument, and sell value Self-motivated and self-directed, with strong emotional intelligence, composure, tenacity, and a results-driven mindset Exceptional collaboration skills and a hunger to exceed customer expectations, with a track record of building positive relationships with colleagues and management peers Direct and respectful communication style and a strong brand ambassador for the business Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a business discipline Experience in geospatial, imagery, mapping, or property intelligence Experience leading sales teams through a period of rapid growth or transformation Additional Information All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Why you'll love working at Nearmap: We move fast and work smart; often wearing multiple hats. We adapted to remote working with ease and are continually looking at ways to improve. We’re proud of our inclusive, supportive culture, and maintain a safe environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging and can be themselves. In addition to your annual leave, Nearmap offers: 4 extra "YOU" days off each year—take a break, no questions asked! Company-sponsored volunteering days to give back. Generous parental leave policies for growing families. Work from Overseas Policy - explore the world in the approved list of cities while you work! Discounted Private Health Insurance plans. A Nearmap subscription (naturally!). Learn More About The Work We Do: YouTube Page LinkedIn Page Thanks, but we got this! Nearmap does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies and search firms. Please do not email or send unsolicited resumes to any Nearmap employee, location or address. Nearmap is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

review_candidates.title: Técnico de Enfermagem - Hemodinâmica
review_candidates.description: Aqui na Unimed JP não paramos de crescer e por isso, estamos com uma oportunidade para quem tem vocação e propósito no cuidar, para atuação como Técnico de Enfermagem no setor de Hemodinâmica . Missão do cargo: Executar com agilidade o acompanhamento dos procedimentos com garantia a segurança do paciente e qualidade na assistência realizada. Atividades: Registrar no prontuário eletrônico – PEP, a assistência prestada ao paciente, visando o controle e a continuidade de acompanhamento da evolução clínica do usuário; Seguir corretamente as rotinas de limpeza e desinfecção dos materiais e equipamentos utilizados, assim como o descarte responsável de acordo com as diretrizes da cooperativa; Registrar as não conformidades e os eventos ocorridos durante o plantão e comunicar ao enfermeiro ou coordenador do processo para eventuais intervenções; Comunicar o enfermeiro e/ou médico responsável sobre possíveis intercorrências, bem como as alterações observadas no estado geral dos pacientes; Verificar necessidade de manutenção dos equipamentos do setor e acionar a área responsável para reparo e calibração; Orientar e executar as atividades de sua competência, participando da elaboração do plano de assistência de enfermagem, alinhado com as normas e procedimentos de biossegurança; Realizar a passagem de plantão conforme práticas de comunicação estruturada da cooperativa; Contribuir (quando necessário) na assistência do setor de diagnóstico por imagem; Ser responsável pelo paciente durante sua permanência na hemodinâmica; Auxiliar o anestesista, quando necessário; Preparar e administrar contraste/medicamentos conforme orientação médica; Solicitar transporte seguro para conduzir o paciente ao seu destino (quando necessário); Organizar salas de exame após sua utilização; Fazer fichas de gastos do paciente/OPME, ao término de cada exame e anexar ao cadastro do mesmo; Renovar estoque de material estéril do setor conforme uso e validade; Convocar equipe de higienização para desinfecção da sala após cada exame e/ou quando necessário; Receber e quando necessário, solicitar roupa limpa para o setor, acondicionando conforme princípios técnicos; Executar outras tarefas correlatas, de acordo com as atribuições da natureza do seu trabalho, tendo domínio de todos os formulários, instruções de trabalho e protocolos do setor, conforme orientação do superior imediato. Requisitos: Ensino Técnico em Enfermagem Completo; Necessário experiência na área em questão; Disponibilidade para atuar como diarista, no horário de 12h às 21h; COREN/PB - Ativo; Declaração de Nada Consta - Válida; Habilidade e destreza na preparação dos pacientes para os exames realizados na Hemodinâmica; Aptidão em administração de contraste e em utilizar equipamentos do setor; Conhecimento sobre qualidade e segurança do paciente; Habilidade em sistemas operacionais (Prontuário Eletrônico).

review_candidates.title: Transformation Manager
review_candidates.description: Role Summary: Responsible for overseeing and leading master data management, portfolio delivery, business analysis, stakeholder management, and process excellence. The role owns logistics master data across the enterprise, from the logistics data workstream of the ERP migration through the establishment of governance processes to ensure data accuracy over time. It also heads the PMO, which governs a large portfolio of cross-functional projects and supply chain system implementations (ex. TMS, WMS, APS, SND, etc), and turns business needs into clear requirements and system designs, and aligns executives, business units, IT, and vendors on priorities and outcomes. It uses process improvement methodologies to redesign processes, remove inefficiencies, and build a continuous improvement culture, so that data, systems, and ways of working hold up as the business grows. Key Responsibilities A) Logistics Master Data (ERP LN to SAP Migration) • Own the logistics master data workstream of the SAP migration, covering data profiling, cleansing, enrichment, and field mapping from LN to SAP, plus mock loads, reconciliation, and cutover sign-off. • Define and maintain logistics data objects, including: -Organizational structure: plants, storage locations, warehouse numbers, shipping points -Material logistics views: units of measure, case and pallet configuration, dimensions and weights, packaging and handling units, batch and shelf-life settings -Warehouse data: storage types, bins, putaway and picking strategies -Transportation data: routes, transportation zones, carriers/business partners, freight lanes and rate structures -Customer logistics data: ship-to locations, delivery windows, unloading points • Keep logistics data consistent across SAP and connected platforms (TMS, WMS, APS) so planning, execution, and costing all work from one version of the truth. • Set up data governance, including ownership and stewardship roles, creation and change workflows, approval controls, and data standards and naming conventions. • Run data quality scorecards and root cause analysis using structured problem-solving. Track completeness, accuracy, duplicates, and timeliness, and drive fixes with process owners. • Partner with the system integrator, Finance, Procurement, Sales, and Supply Chain on data design decisions and on dependencies with other master data domains (material, customer, vendor, finance). • Build and lead the master data team, and write SOPs, data dictionaries, and training for data maintainers. B) Transformation & Digital Enablement • Lead end-to-end implementation of TMS, WMS, and APS (demand, supply, and inventory optimization). • Deliver measurable outcomes such as cost savings, forecast accuracy, inventory accuracy, warehouse productivity, and route optimization, and track benefits after go-live. • Drive user adoption across multi-site operations (100+ users) through training, change management, and hypercare. • Manage logistics capital projects such as mega depots and distribution centers, from construction through 3PL selection and systems go-live. C) PMO & Portfolio Governance • Head the PMO, managing a team of about 10+ concurrent cross-functional projects. • Standardize delivery frameworks, stage gates, and reporting. • Support IT portfolio budgeting and project approval with the Management Committee. D) Process Excellence & Leadership • Map, analyze, and redesign processes using process improvement methodologies, and find automation opportunities. • Lead requirements gathering and business analysis for system and data initiatives. • Act as the bridge between business, IT, vendors, and executive leadership, and coach and develop team members. Job Qualifications: • Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or related field. Master’s Degree or equivalent experience is an advantage. • Relevant experience in supply chain transformation, ERP implementation, master data management, PMO, business analysis, or process excellence. • Strong knowledge of logistics and supply chain processes, including warehousing, transportation, distribution, inventory, and planning. • Experience in ERP data migration and master data governance, including profiling, cleansing, mapping, validation, reconciliation, and data quality management. • Working knowledge of SAP and/or supply chain systems such as WMS, TMS, or APS; SAP S/4HANA and Infor LN experience is an advantage. • Strong project/portfolio management, business analysis, requirements management, and process improvement skills. • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Power BI or similar data analysis and visualization tools. • Strong stakeholder, change management, communication, and influencing skills, with experience engaging senior leadership, cross-functional teams, IT, and external partners. • Demonstrated people leadership and team development capabilities. • Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and strategic thinking skills. • Project management, Agile/Scrum, Lean, Six Sigma, or other relevant certifications are an advantage. Note: Candidate must be willing to report onsite at least four (4) days per week in Ortigas, Pasig, with one (1) work-from-home day weekly.
